title: score-dev.ts: match a label to an analyzer symbol by declaration site, not qualname (DEC-303 (a93) item 4)
description: DEC-303 (a93) item 4, Q-B A made exact: score-dev.ts matches an analyzer symbol to a label by DECLARATION SITE (file plus the def's line and column), never by a loosened, suffix or fuzzy qualname. The analyzer and its shipped output are untouched. Controls: re-scoring the same rich labels at dev 0e72f09 flips exactly 22.0 and nothing else (61/66 instead of 60/66); a fixture with two same-named nested classes at different declaration sites is refused for the wrong one. Pre-read done for the ruling's before-building step: at rich pin 3a109ccd the real lexical nesting of RichFormatter is install (rich/pretty.py:155) -> display_hook (184) -> class RichFormatter at rich/pretty.py:214, where the class keyword sits at column 9 and the declared name, which the scorer matches, at column 15; the census qualname install.display_hook.RichFormatter states that real nesting, and the analyzer emits install.RichFormatter, dropping display_hook, so a separate ordinary naming follow-up is filed, no hold. Lands before the pre-registration; two rounds.

acceptanceCriteria.text: score-dev.ts resolves each label target to an analyzer symbol by declaration site (file, def line and column) and never by qualname equality, suffix or fuzzy match
Re-scoring the rich labels at dev 0e72f09 reports 61/66 with exactly 22.0 flipped and no other site changed
A fixture with two same-named nested classes at different declaration sites is refused when the edge points at the wrong one
The analyzer and its shipped output are unchanged by the change

plan: 1. Read score-dev.ts, census.py and the enum/symbol shapes; confirm the declaration-site key (file, name line, name column) on both sides.
2. Record column in census.py (1-based name column) and regenerate enum-rich.json; verify targets, order and sites are unchanged apart from the added column.
3. Replace score-dev.ts qualname lookup with a declaration-site index; keep a documented unique-line fallback only for enums that predate the column; analyzer and shipped output untouched.
4. Add a self-test script whose fixture has two same-named nested classes at different declaration sites and refuses the wrong one; observe a mutant on the matching check red.
5. Re-score the rich labels at dev 3062aa9f and report exactly 22.0 flipped (61/66), no other site changed; typecheck, lint, format and tests.
6. Close GCLI-142 in the same PR (records commit) citing #257/#258/#259.
implementationNotes:
IMPLEMENTATION AND EVIDENCE (GCLI-168, two-round task; round 1 record).

Approach: census.py now records each target's declaration site column (1-based start of the declared name, m.start(3)+1). enum-rich.json was regenerated with the same seed and max-targets (gcli142-dev-rich-1, 200) and verified identical to the committed enumeration in every target, order and site apart from the added column. score-dev.ts builds a DeclarationIndex from the analyzer symbols and matches a target by (file, line, column); the qualname is used only in the printed miss line and never for matching. A target from an enum without a column (tqdm, flask, generated before this change) is matched on the declaration line only when exactly one symbol sits there, and stays unresolved when the line is ambiguous. No src/ file and no shipped output changed.

Refusal fixture: new score-dev-selftest.ts (not a *.test.ts, so no workflow runs it) analyzes two same-named classes declared in the same function at different sites; the analyzer gives both the qualname outer.Twin (m.py:2:11 and m.py:4:11). Checks: each site resolves to its own symbol; an edge to the wrong twin is refused, symmetrically; an empty edge set is refused; a pre-column target on a one-symbol line resolves; a pre-column target on a two-symbol line (class One: pass; class Two: pass) is refused. All pass.

Control: the old qualname scorer scored the rich labels 60/66. The new scorer at dev 3062aa9f (src unchanged since 0e72f09) scores 61/66 = 0.9242, and the miss-set diff is exactly one line removed: 22.0 RichFormatter() at rich/pretty.py:233. No other label changed.

Mutant observed red: replacing the declaration-site lookup in symbolIdForTarget with the qualname key (byQualname, last-wins) turned exactly three of the selftest's eleven checks red — "the first site resolves to the first symbol", "an edge to the right twin resolves", "an edge to the wrong twin is refused" — while the second-twin, symmetry, empty-set and legacy checks stayed green; exit 1. The good file was restored and the selftest passes.

Record correction (round-1 reviewer finding 5, 2026-11-27): the earlier description said RichFormatter is at 'col 9'. Column 9 is the class keyword; the declared name, which the scorer matches, is at column 15 (enum-rich.json target 22, column 15; the analyzer symbol id is rich/pretty.py:214:15). The description is corrected. Round 2 carries the other non-blocking round-1 findings: the same-line selftest precondition that exactly two symbols exist on n.py line 1, the vacuous empty-edge-set check dropped, and a README Limits line for census.py reading utf8 rather than utf-8-sig (a def on line 1 of a BOM file is skipped).
